premise: Neon City hired OmniClean to scrub every alley spotless. Their polite MOP robots smile in sync, march in lockstep, and bag every stray that doesn't shine. Bandit — masked vigilante of the alleys, hero to the city's strays — steals back through each district to free the crew and put a dent in the MOP-9000's perfect city.
tagline: One city's trash is one raccoon's treasure.

introPanels.caption: Neon Docks after-hours: strays living large in the alley glow.
introPanels.artHint: raccoon crew partying in alley neon

introPanels.caption: OmniClean's MOPs arrived smiling. In perfect sync. All of them. Creepy.
introPanels.artHint: synchronized polite MOP robots swoop into alley in lockstep

introPanels.caption: One polite 'excuse me' later, the crew was bagged for sanitation.
introPanels.artHint: crew stuffed into MOP bags by smiling robots

introPanels.caption: Bandit slipped the sweep. The alleys still needed a vigilante.
introPanels.artHint: Bandit escaping down wet alley with mask

introPanels.caption: Mask on. Hero to the strays. Time to un-clean the city.
introPanels.artHint: Bandit puts on the mask as alley vigilante

neon_docks.title: Neon Docks
neon_docks.flavor: Where the trash tide meets the neon — and OmniClean wants both spotless.

arcade_row.title: Arcade Row
arcade_row.flavor: High scores, higher stakes. The lights never blink — the MOPs do. Together.

rooftops.title: Rooftops
rooftops.flavor: Jump the skyline. Don't look down. Definitely don't look at the scrubbers marching in step.

sewer_grid.title: Sewer Grid
sewer_grid.flavor: OmniClean's dirty secret: the shine starts underground — and so does the resistance.

crew.name: Scrapz
crew.line: If it's bolted down, it's a suggestion.

crew.name: Glitch
crew.line: I speak fluent static — and terrible advice.

crew.name: Fizz
crew.line: Shake me and I explode... with enthusiasm.

paTaunts: OmniClean PA: Spotless is kindness. Strays are… a scheduling conflict.
OmniClean PA: Please remain orderly while we collect the irregulars.
OmniClean PA: Your shine rating just dropped. How unfortunate for you.
OmniClean PA: The MOP-9000 appreciates your cooperation. And your dustpan.
OmniClean PA: Resistance noted. Applying industrial-strength pep talk. Synchronize.
OmniClean PA: A masked pest is still a pest. Smile for the sweep.
